@@ -0,0 +1,162 @@
+name: PIP Audit
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - master
+
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+  pull-requests: write
+
+jobs:
+  audit:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    container:
+      image: opendatacanada/ckan-pytest  # primary executor
+    steps:
+      - name: Check Source Dependency Versions
+        run: |
+          source /srv/app/venv/bin/activate
+          for dir in /srv/app/src/*; do
+            srcName=$(echo "$dir" | awk -F'/' '{print $NF}');
+            if [[ -d "$dir/.git"  ]]; then
+                printf "\n${srcName}: Checking for updates..."
+                cd $dir;
+                current_branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD);
+                if [[ "$srcName" == "ckan" ]]; then
+                    git fetch canada;
+                    reslog=$(git log HEAD..canada/$current_branch --oneline);
+                else
+                    git fetch origin;
+                    reslog=$(git log HEAD..origin/$current_branch --oneline);
+                fi;
+                if [[ "${reslog}" == "" ]]; then
+                    printf "\n${srcName}: Up to date. Skipping..."
+                else
+                    git pull --ff-only || true;
+                    printf "\n${srcName}: Pulled updated code. Re-initializing in python environment..."
+                    cd /srv/app;
+                    if [[ -f "$dir/requirements.txt" ]]; then
+                        pip install -r $dir/requirements.txt || true;
+                    fi;
+                    if [[ -f "$dir/dev-requirements.txt" ]]; then
+                        pip install -r $dir/dev-requirements.txt || true;
+                    fi;
+                    if [[ -f "$dir/test-requirements.txt" ]]; then
+                        pip install -r $dir/test-requirements.txt || true;
+                    fi;
+                    if [[ -f "$dir/setup.py" ]]; then
+                        python $dir/setup.py develop || true;
+                    fi;
+                fi;
+            else
+                printf "\n${srcName}: Not a source repository. Skipping..."
+            fi;
+          done;
+          cd /srv/app;
+      - name: Checkout Repository (${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }})
+        id: gitcheckout
+        run: |
+          cd /srv/app/src/ckanext-canada
+          git fetch origin
+          if [[ "${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}" != "master" ]]; then
+            git checkout -b ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }} origin/${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
+          fi;
+          git fetch
+          git pull --ff-only || true
+          source /srv/app/venv/bin/activate
+          pip install -e .
+          pip install -r requirements.txt
+          pip install -r test-requirements.txt
+          if [[ -f "requirements-security-patch.txt" ]]; then
+            pip install -r requirements-security-patch.txt
+          fi;
+          python3 setup.py develop
+          pip install -e 'git+https://github.com/open-data/ckanext-cloudstorage.git@canada-v2.10#egg=ckanext-cloudstorage' -r 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-data/ckanext-cloudstorage/canada-v2.10/requirements.txt'
+          pip install -e 'git+https://github.com/open-data/ckanext-power-bi@main#egg=ckanext-power-bi' -r 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-data/ckanext-power-bi/main/requirements.txt'
+          pip install pip-audit
+          cd /srv/app
+      - name: Run Audit
+        id: audit
+        if: steps.gitcheckout.outcome == 'success'
+        run: |
+          cd /srv/app/src/ckanext-canada
+          source /srv/app/venv/bin/activate
+          pip-audit --format=json --output=pip-audit.json || true
+          python3 pip_audit.py
+      - name: Check for Security Patch Changes
+        id: secchanges
+        if: steps.audit.outcome == 'success'
+        run: |
+          cd /srv/app/src/ckanext-canada
+          if git diff --quiet -- requirements-security-patch.txt; then
+            echo "changes=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          else
+            echo "changes=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+      - name: Checkout Repository for Actions
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        id: hascheckout
+        if: steps.audit.outcome == 'success'
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - name: Copy Security Requirements
+        id: haschanges
+        if: steps.hascheckout.outcome == 'success'
+        run: |
+          cp /srv/app/src/ckanext-canada/requirements-security-patch.txt \
+            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/requirements-security-patch.txt"
+          cp /srv/app/src/ckanext-canada/pip-audit.json \
+            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/pip-audit.json"
+          cp /srv/app/src/ckanext-canada/pip-changes.txt \
+            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/pip-changes.txt"
+          cp /srv/app/src/ckanext-canada/pip-slack.json \
+            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/pip-slack.json"
+      - name: Slack Notification
+        if: steps.haschanges.outcome == 'success'
+        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.23.0
+        with:
+          payload-file-path: pip-slack.json
+        env:
+          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
+          SLACK_WEBHOOK_TYPE: INCOMING_WEBHOOK
+      - name: Create Pull Request
+        id: crpr
+        if: steps.secchanges.outputs.changes == 'true'
+        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
+        with:
+          commit-message: |
+            patch(security): pip audit;
+          branch: "feature/security-requirements-patch"
+          base: release
+          delete-branch: true
+          title: "[SECURITY] New PIP Fix Releases"
+          body: |
+            Security Dependency Updates
+
+            This pull request contains recommended dependency updates generated by pip-audit.
+
+            Please review the proposed versions before merging.
+          reviewers: JVickery-TBS, RabiaSajjad
+          add-paths: |
+            requirements-security-patch.txt
+      - name: Create Change Log
+        if: ${{ steps.crpr.outputs.pull-request-number }}
+        run: |
+          git config --global --add safe.directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
+
+          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
+
+          git fetch origin feature/security-requirements-patch
+          git checkout feature/security-requirements-patch
+
+          CHANGELOG="changes/${{ steps.crpr.outputs.pull-request-number }}.security"
+
+          cp pip-changes.txt "$CHANGELOG"
+
+          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
+          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
+          git add "$CHANGELOG"
+          git commit -m "feat(misc): changelog; [skip ci]"
+          git push origin feature/security-requirements-patch

+import json
+import urllib.request
+import urllib.error
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.parse import quote
+
+from packaging.version import Version
+from packaging.specifiers import SpecifierSet
+from packaging.utils import canonicalize_name
+from packaging.requirements import Requirement, InvalidRequirement
+
+TARGET_PYTHON = Version('3.9.2')
+AUDIT_FILE = Path('pip-audit.json')
+REQUIREMENTS_FILE = Path('requirements-security-patch.txt')
+CKAN_REQUIREMENTS_FILE = Path('/srv/app/src/ckan/requirements.txt')
+CHANGELOG_FILE = Path('pip-changes.txt')
+SLACK_FILE = Path('pip-slack.json')
+EXCLUDED_PACKAGES = {
+    canonicalize_name('pkg-resources'),
+}
+METADATA_CACHE = {}
+
+packages = {}
+audit = json.loads(AUDIT_FILE.read_text())
+changelog = ['New security patches from pip-audit', '',
+             f'Target Python version: {TARGET_PYTHON}', '']
+slack_reports = {}
+
+
+def load_ckan_pins(requirements_file):
+    pins = {}
+    if not requirements_file.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f'CKAN requirements file '
+                                f'not found: {requirements_file}')
+    for line_number, raw_line in enumerate(requirements_file.read_text().splitlines(),
+                                           start=1):
+        line = raw_line.strip()
+        if not line or line.startswith('#') or line.startswith('-'):
+            continue
+        requirement_text = line.split('#', 1)[0].strip()
+        try:
+            requirement = Requirement(requirement_text)
+        except InvalidRequirement:
+            continue
+        package = canonicalize_name(requirement.name)
+        exact_pins = [
+            spec.version
+            for spec in requirement.specifier
+            if spec.operator == '==' and '*' not in spec.version
+        ]
+        if len(exact_pins) != 1:
+            continue
+        version = exact_pins[0]
+        if package in pins and pins[package][1] != version:
+            raise ValueError('Conflicting CKAN pins for '
+                             f'{requirement.name} at line {line_number}')
+        pins[package] = (requirement.name, version)
+    return pins
+
+
+ckan_pins = load_ckan_pins(CKAN_REQUIREMENTS_FILE)
+
+
+def add_email_report_entry(name, installed_version, reasons, vulnerability=None):
+    if name not in slack_reports:
+        slack_reports[name] = {'installed_version': installed_version,
+                               'reasons': reasons,
+                               'vulnerabilities': []}
+
+    if vulnerability:
+        slack_reports[name]['vulnerabilities'].append({
+            'id': vulnerability.get('id', 'Unknown ID'),
+            'fix_versions': vulnerability.get('fix_versions', [])
+        })
+
+
+def get_requires_python(name, version):
+    key = (canonicalize_name(name), str(version))
+    if key in METADATA_CACHE:
+        return METADATA_CACHE[key]
+    url = f'https://pypi.org/pypi/{quote(name, safe="")}' + \
+        f'/{quote(str(version), safe="")}/json'
+
+    try:
+        request = urllib.request.Request(
+            url, headers={'User-Agent': 'CKAN-Security-Audit/1.0'})
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
+            data = json.loads(response.read())
+        result = data.get('info', {}).get('requires_python')
+    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ValueError) as exc:
+        print(f'WARNING: Could not retrieve {name}=={version}: {exc}')
+        result = None
+    METADATA_CACHE[key] = result
+    return result
+
+
+def supports_python(name, version):
+    requires_python = get_requires_python(name, version)
+    if requires_python is None:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return TARGET_PYTHON in SpecifierSet(requires_python)
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
+
+def select_fix_version(installed_version, candidates):
+    if not candidates:
+        return None
+    installed = Version(installed_version)
+    same_branch = [
+        version for version in candidates
+        if version.release[:2] == installed.release[:2]
+    ]
+    if same_branch:
+        return min(same_branch)
+    return min(candidates)
+
+
+if REQUIREMENTS_FILE.exists():
+    for line_number, raw_line in enumerate(REQUIREMENTS_FILE.read_text().splitlines(),
+                                           start=1):
+        line = raw_line.strip()
+        if not line or line.startswith('#') or line.startswith('-'):
+            continue
+        requirement_text = line.split('#', 1)[0].strip()
+        if not line or line.startswith('#') or '==' not in line:
+            continue
+        name, version = requirement_text.split('==', 1)
+        package_key = canonicalize_name(name)
+        if package_key in EXCLUDED_PACKAGES or package_key.startswith('ckanext-'):
+            continue
+        try:
+            parsed_version = Version(version)
+        except Exception:
+            print(f'WARNING: Invalid version: {requirement_text}')
+            continue
+        compatible = supports_python(name, parsed_version)
+        if compatible is False:
+            print(f'REMOVED: {name}=={version} (incompatible '
+                  f'with Python {TARGET_PYTHON})')
+            continue
+        if compatible is None:
+            print(f'WARNING: Could not verify Python '
+                  f'compatibility for {name}=={version}')
+            continue
+        packages[package_key] = {'name': name, 'version': parsed_version}
+
+for dependency in audit.get('dependencies', []):
+    name = dependency['name']
+    installed_version = dependency.get('version')
+    if name in EXCLUDED_PACKAGES or name.startswith('ckanext-'):
+        continue
+    if not installed_version:
+        print(f'WARNING: Skipping {name}: no installed version in audit results')
+        continue
+    package_key = canonicalize_name(name)
+    if package_key in EXCLUDED_PACKAGES or package_key.startswith('ckanext-'):
+        continue
+    vulnerabilities = dependency.get('vulns') or []
+    if not vulnerabilities:
+        continue
+    ckan_detail = ''
+    if package_key in ckan_pins:
+        ckan_name, ckan_version = ckan_pins[package_key]
+        ckan_detail = 'CKAN 2.10 pins this dependency to ' + \
+            f'`{ckan_name}=={ckan_version}`. Vulnerability remains unresolved.'
+    package_fixes = []
+    for vuln in vulnerabilities:
+        vuln_id = vuln['id']
+        fix_versions = vuln.get('fix_versions') or []
+        compatible = []
+        incompatible = []
+        unknown = []
+        for fix in fix_versions:
+            try:
+                version = Version(fix)
+            except Exception:
+                continue
+            result = supports_python(name, version)
+            if result is True:
+                compatible.append(version)
+            elif result is False:
+                incompatible.append(version)
+            else:
+                unknown.append(version)
+        details = []
+        if compatible:
+            details.append('Python 3.9 compatible: ' +
+                           ', '.join(map(str, sorted(compatible))))
+        if incompatible:
+            incompatible_details = []
+            for version in sorted(incompatible):
+                requires_python = get_requires_python(name, version)
+                incompatible_details.append(
+                    f'{version} (requires Python {requires_python})')
+            details.append('requires newer Python: ' + ', '.join(incompatible_details))
+        if unknown:
+            details.append('compatibility unknown: ' +
+                           ', '.join(map(str, sorted(unknown))))
+        if package_key in ['ckan', 'ckanapi']:
+            details.append('installed from source')
+        if ckan_detail or not compatible or package_key in ['ckan', 'ckanapi']:
+            if not fix_versions:
+                details.append('no fix version listed')
+            if ckan_detail:
+                details.append(ckan_detail)
+            add_email_report_entry(name=name, installed_version=installed_version,
+                                   reasons=details, vulnerability=vuln)
+        else:
+            changelog.append(f'  - {name}: {vuln_id} '
+                             f'({"; ".join(details) or "no usable fix version"})')
+        if not compatible:
+            continue
+        selected = select_fix_version(installed_version, compatible)
+        if selected:
+            package_fixes.append(selected)
+    if not package_fixes:
+        continue
+    recommended_version = max(package_fixes)
+    if supports_python(name, recommended_version) is not True:
+        changelog.append(f'  - {name}: no verified combined '
+                         f'Python {TARGET_PYTHON} recommendation')
+        continue
+    existing = packages.get(package_key)
+    if existing is None or recommended_version > existing['version']:
+        packages[package_key] = {'name': name, 'version': recommended_version,
+                                 'ckan_pinned': False}
+    if package_key in ckan_pins:
+        ckan_name, ckan_version = ckan_pins[package_key]
+        packages[package_key]['name'] = ckan_name
+        packages[package_key]['version'] = ckan_version
+        packages[package_key]['ckan_pinned'] = True
+
+
+def split_slack_text(text, max_length=1900):
+    chunks = []
+    while len(text) > max_length:
+        split_at = text.rfind('\n', 0, max_length)
+        if split_at == -1:
+            split_at = max_length
+        chunks.append(text[:split_at])
+        text = text[split_at:].lstrip('\n')
+    if text:
+        chunks.append(text)
+    return chunks
+
+
+def generate_report(reports):
+    blocks = [
+        {
+            'type': 'header',
+            'text': {
+                'type': 'plain_text',
+                'text': 'Unsupported Python Packages :rotating_light:',
+                'emoji': True,
+            },
+        },
+        {
+            'type': 'section',
+            'fields': [
+                {'type': 'mrkdwn', 'text': '*Project:*\nCKAN'},
+                {'type': 'mrkdwn', 'text': f'*Target Python:*\n{TARGET_PYTHON}'},
+            ],
+        },
+        {'type': 'divider'},
+    ]
+    for i, name in enumerate(sorted(reports, key=str.lower)):
+        entry = reports[name]
+        text = f'*{name}* (installed: `{entry["installed_version"]}`)\n\n*Reasons:*\n'
+        for r in entry['reasons']:
+            text += f'• {r}\n'
+        text += '\n*Vulnerabilities:*\n'
+        for vuln in entry['vulnerabilities']:
+            fix_text = ', '.join(f'`{v}`' for v in vuln['fix_versions']) \
+                if vuln['fix_versions'] else 'None listed'
+            text += f'• `{vuln["id"]}` — Available fixes: {fix_text}\n'
+        text = text.strip()
+        chunks = split_slack_text(text, max_length=2900)
+        for chunk in chunks:
+            blocks.append({
+                'type': 'section',
+                'text': {
+                    'type': 'mrkdwn',
+                    'text': chunk,
+                },
+            })
+        if i + 1 < len(reports):
+            blocks.append({'type': 'divider'})
+    return {'blocks': blocks}
+
+
+requirements = []
+for package in sorted(packages):
+    details = packages[package]
+    name = details['name']
+    if name in ['ckan', 'ckanapi']:
+        continue  # never have ckan or ckanapi as a requirement, we install from source
+    version = details['version']
+    if details.get('ckan_pinned', False):
+        requirements.append(f'{name}=={version}  # Pinned by CKAN requirements.txt;')
+        continue
+    requirements.append(f'{name}=={version}')
+
+REQUIREMENTS_FILE.write_text(
+    '# NOTE: file is managed by pip-audit workflow, '
+    'see .github/workflows/pip_audit.yml\n' +
+    '\n'.join(requirements) + '\n')
+CHANGELOG_FILE.write_text('\n'.join(changelog) + '\n')
+SLACK_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(
+    generate_report(slack_reports), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+name: Security Audit Pipeline
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [ main ]
+  schedule:
+    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+jobs:
+  security-audit:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Set up Python
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.12.15'
+          
+      - name: Install pip-audit
+        run: |
+          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
+          pip install pip-audit
+
+      - name: Run pip-audit
+        id: audit_packages
+        continue-on-error: true
+        run: |
+          pip-audit -r requirements.txt --fix --dry-run --format markdown > pip-audit_report.md
+
+      - name: Create Slack Payload File
+        if: always() && steps.audit_packages.outcome == 'failure'
+        run: |
+          if [ -f pip-audit_report.md ]; then
+            cat pip-audit_report.md | \
+              sed -E 's/\[([^]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/\1/g' | \
+              sed 's/--- | --- | --- | ---//g' | \
+              sed 's/Name | Version | ID | Fix Versions/PACKAGE   | VERSION | ID                   | FIX VERSION/g' > consolidated_logs.tmp
+          fi
+          node -e '
+            const fs = require("fs");
+            const repo = process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY || "repo";
+            let logs = "";
+            if (fs.existsSync("consolidated_logs.tmp")) {
+              logs = fs.readFileSync("consolidated_logs.tmp", "utf8");
+            }
+            const payload = {
+              text: `:rotating_light: Vulnerabilities detected in repo: *${repo}* \n\n\`\`\`\n${logs}\`\`\``
+            };
+            fs.writeFileSync("slack_payload.json", JSON.stringify(payload));
+          '
+
+      - name: Send Slack Notification
+        if: always() && hashFiles('slack_payload.json') != ''
+        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v2.0.0
+        with:
+          webhook: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
